column3: All right, you murderous thug, kindly pull over and let me arrest you.
Come back when you have a ticket!
We sold out months ago. Try again next century.
No chance, friend! This show was sold out before you were conceived!
Hey! No ticket, no entry!
You've got to help me! I have to find out what happened to my baby boy!
Oh, I'm sorry. I thought you was a city slicker, but I ain't telling you nothing less than you help us with the harvest.

Okay, around town, you'll probably run into a few people I like to call losers. Maybe they need a ride, or maybe they need help. Whatever, the point is, once you've helped them out, they will be available to help drive your lazy butt around.
Try breaking knees with a stomp attack. Press the A button twice to do a double jump, and then press the B button to do a stomp. That much butt-pounds will break through anything!
Try breaking these with a stomp attack. Press the X button twice to do a double jump, and then press the square button to do a stomp. That much butt poundage will break through anything!
Try breaking these with a stomp attack. Press the A button twice to do a double jump, and then press the X button to do a stomp. That much butt-pattage will break through anything.
FREEDOM!
Go up to a box and press the B button to smash it.
Oh, I've heard about these. There's some promotion going on all over town. That means it's time to use a little smashy-smashy. Go up to a box and press the square button to smash it.
Oh, I've heard about these. There's some promotion going on all over town. That means it's time to use a little smashy-smashy. Go up to a box and press the X button to smash it.
That's the stuff, Psycho! And so it begins.

Nobody knows why these things have turned up all over Springfield. They always seem to turn up whenever something exciting happens. I don't know what they are, but violence is always an appropriate response in the face of the unknown.

There's some collector cards hidden all over Springfield. Find the other ones and sweet reward is yours for the taking. If you want to take a closer look at the cards, you can see them in the pause menu. And don't get your stinky fingers on them, fatty!
Hey Homer, how about a breakfast churro?
No time! Tell me where to find Mr. Smithers!
Yeah, I think I saw him at the Quickie Mart. More breakfast churros for Lenny!
Uh-oh! It's that evil black car! I've got to get that waste before he wastes me!
Whenever you see this icon, you know you can buy new clothes. Don't worry, they have size 48 pants with a balloon seat for gluttonous slobs like yourself.
Hello, famous American clown. I wish to ask a favor.
Everyone wants to wet their beaks.
I require information about drugs delivering evil cola. How can I get this classified data?
Sorry, Apu. I'm a drink-squeezy punchy lowlife. You need a professional scumbag. Follow a cop until you find one.
Ooh, brain like shiny thing.
Yeah, great. Those shiny things are called coins. Whenever you get enough of those, you can get a cool surprise.
Bart, do you recognize this design?
That's the alien mind control cola. They gave us tons of that up in the alien spaceship. They're using it to make the town go crazy.
Oh, thank God! You snapped out of your trance! I was so worried!
Later, I'm going to the arcade.
Congratulations! You erased a small amount of the Simpsons' shame.
Okay, Mr. Squishy. You've earned a little reward. Call the DMV and we'll deliver your new ride to you.
Thanks! I guess.
Don't mention it. Call the DMV when you want your new car delivered.
Brains! Brains! Brains!
BRAINS! BRAINS!
Brains! Brains! Brains!
Hooray! That was the last one! Now Krusty Burger will have to consider a moss-based substitute.
This is a moment of joy for us both.
Damn city folk and your hostile takeovers!
Uh-oh, that's one angry agrarian. Punch it, Apu!
Wow, you really homerized that car! Don't worry, just sit tight for a few seconds and everything will be as good as new. Why? Who knows. I just reads what they tells me.

Okay, homeboy, here's how you drive this thing. Press the A button to accelerate, and use the control stick to steer. The X button is your brake in reverse, and the B button is your handbrake. You know, just like every driving game ever.

Okay homeboy, here's how you drive this crapbox. Press the X button to accelerate and use the left analog stick or directional button to steer. The circle button is your brake in reverse and the square button is your handbrake. You know, just like every driving game ever.

Okay homeboy, here's how you drive this thing. Press the A button to accelerate and use the left thumbstick or directional pad to steer. The B button is your brake in reverse and the X button is your handbrake. You know, just like every driving game ever.
I'm afraid we have a medical emergency.
Oh no! My babies!

Your babies are about to go to the bathroom all over my waiting room. And diapers aren't covered by your insurance. Ooh, you better hurry. I heard the parents of the Shelbyville Nand are grabbing every diaper in town.
Oh, I could watch you fail all day. And I often do.
Don't feel too bad, Bart. Your Bouvier gene is clearly recessive.
You lost. And don't blame it on Homer.
Sorry, handsome. If you want to earn that car, you'll have to do a lot better than that.
Sorry, Nahasa Pasawata, whatever. That just wasn't good enough.
Go cry to your elephant god!
You really are an underachiever.
The apple of sucking doesn't fall far from the suck tree, does it?
That was so bad, we won't even give you your license when you're 16.
Raaaaaargh!
E.I.P.I.N.C.O.T.A.N.U.N.S.S.U.S.P.O.R.S.A.N.C.O.T.A.N.C.O.T.A.N.C.O.T.A.N.C.O.T.A.N.C
Grrrrrrrr!
Oof, I feel a need to wash myself vigorously.
So how did I do?
Homer, you've finally found a way to make me happy. By letting me flunk you.
At the rate you're going, you couldn't pass a kidney stone.
The Army should bottle failure like that and drop it on our enemies.
Tell me again why I waste so much encouragement on a pathetic loser like you.
Well, it looks like you're your father's son after all, Bart. I was hoping you were someone else's.
Bart, you've gotta be the worst 10-year-old driver in town.
Come on, Lisa. Even Bart managed to drive better than that.
Your grandmother must be rolling over in her grave right now.
Well, you can't spell failure without L-I-S-A.
If you want the car, you'll have to try again. Or leave Homer.
Sheesh! Even Maggie did better than that!
Marge, you're just like your vacuum cleaner. You suck.
Sorry, Mr. Squishy, but that just doesn't cut it. Maybe if you unbutton your shirt, you might do better.
Come on, Bart. Even Milhouse could do better than that.
I don't know how a little loser like you could do so poorly.
Raaaaaargh!
RAAAAAAAGH!
Grrrrrrrr!
Okay, now I am scared.
Ooh, that hurts.
Stop hurting my feelings.
I thought Grandma was still alive!
I'm too sad to even question that.
I'll try again, thank you.
I laugh so hard my lung hurts.
I CAN HEAR YOU!
Of course, dead people can't roll over.
Damn it!
I would have been a great parent.
Yeah, I know.
Well, Dad, you failed that just like you failed at life, but unlike life, here you get a do-over. You sicken me.
One fish delivered to a happy home.
So what about this clutch of primates?
They dispense the millions of green currency credits required to build the recreational software.
What do Earthlings do with these green credits?
They are used to control the rationing of essential items like food and toilet seats.
If I get another memo from that guy, I swear I'm going to PLOTS!
Run free! No, wait! Swim free!
There are a bunch of these scattered in each level. Little surprises are hidden inside each one. Be sure to come back again to see if there's something you missed.
If you ever feel like getting a new set of wheels and you're not picky, just talk to ol' Gil. He's always got a couple of crap boxes to sell.
Have a good life!
Bart Simpson, drive that car back to your fourth grade class at once.
Oh, he's like an unstoppable school making me a ten guy!
What possible service could this be to the community?
Shut up and take us back to the hideout. I mean, um, charity place.
Okay, while this is the worst city in America, our police will only ignore minor crimes like petty larceny and counterfeiting. Do too much damage, and they're on you, man.
May your days be filled with hook-free worms!
Press the Y button to get in the car. And don't take all day, this is the tutorial.
Press the triangle button to get into the car, and don't take all day, this is a tutorial.
Press the Y button to get into the car and don't take all day. This is just a tutorial.
You can go inside certain buildings by pressing the Y button. Why did I agree to do this stupid tutorial? It is so boring!
You can go inside certain buildings by pressing the triangle button. Ugh, why did I agree to do this stupid tutorial? It is so boring!
You can go inside certain buildings by pressing the Y button. Why did I agree to do this stupid tutorial? It is so boring!
Grandpa, can you help me find Bart? He's missing.
Maybe I'm just a senile old man, but Bart's lucky red hat fell out of that black car.
Wow, Grandpa. What a great clue. You showed why senior citizens are valuable members of the community.
I think my baby teeth are growing back! That's why I had to punch that nurse!
Whenever you need to save a little time, just cut through one of these Krusty ads.
Hi, Dr. Nick!
Hi, everybody!
You seem like a heavy drinker. Do you have a blender?
Not now, okay? My monkeys have escaped! Can you catch them for me? I'll be so grateful!
Why won't they come back to you?
Because I have tortured them horribly, silly!
Next time, watch out for Nets, dummy!

Okay, you've ditched the wheels. No problem. Use the control stick to move around. This is called walking. Press the A button to jump and hold down the X button to run. Anytime you're in the air, hit jump again to get a little extra push.

Okay, you've ditched the wheels. No problem. Use the directional button or the left analog stick to move around. This is called walking. Press the X button to jump and hold down the circle button to run. Anytime you're in the air, hit jump again to get a little extra push.

Okay, you've ditched the wheels. No problem. Use the left analog thumbstick to move around. This is called walking. Press the A button to jump and hold down the B button to run. Anytime you're in the air, hit the jump again to get a little extra push.
Oh, my face is all hurty!
There's plenty of good living here.
Hey, you there! Smelly Sam! What's going on?
The alien craft is using some sort of tractor beam to suck up trespassers to their doom. Worst. Effects. Ever.
But that's real!
Worst. Effects. Ever.
What's with the cool black car?

If my knowledge of sci-fi movies is correct, which it is, the black car is an advanced probe for the mothership. Now, if you're through, I will spend my last hours on Earth complaining about movies on the Internet.
The gift of life is wasted on you.
Now to kick some zombie butt with a little help from my most psychotic friend, Moe.
That guy deserves such a probing!
Who are these people? I never saw them during production.
They implement torture and punishment. The other drones scuttle and run at their approach.
What is the difference between an associate producer and a producer anyway?
If you ask me, these humans spent too much time exchanging long protein strands with one another.
Here's how this works. Millhouse, Nelson, and Ralph run a series of races around town. Complete all the races and you unlock a new vehicle. Well, what are you waiting for?
Whenever you're chasing someone down, you can use this little radar here.
Talk about a waste of DNA!
Indeed, I met smarter people in the drunk tank.
These humans made me look fat!
Oh, stop it! You're as thin as the day I birthed you!
These people made the quote movies in the software. Hopefully not everyone will skip their creations as I did.
Huh! I've blown better special effects out of my smell hole!
And here's Mr. Gold Probing Device himself.
I really have no idea what these people did.
Next year, let's use the female for our cross-fertilization initiative.
Ha! She wouldn't give you ten seconds!
One of these guys had the creepiest forehead.
This one is the alpha male. His sweet odor and brightly colored shirts ensure his dominance.
He'll never know his workers have been slowly poisoning him.
And these bipeds?
They are the slave underclass, tied to radiation dispensers day and night.
Truly, death is their only release.
This one is most entertaining. I laid my eggs in his brain tissue.
So these must be the auditory humanoids. Strange how they are all so old.
The Earthlings never learned we replaced these guys with clones eons ago.
To them, our bloody vengeance will soon be complete.
These humans were okay.
This guy was always saying, don't go there. What a loser.
So few cards! I laugh at you! Ha ha!

Don't touch that! That is a ticket to the unreleased Itchy & Scratchy episode! I will only trade that for a complete set of collector cards. Please to note, I said complete. I'm not going through that crap again.

Oh, finally! Sheesh, I thought you were never going to figure it out. Now I can explain what these phone booths are all about. Whenever you want to change cars or call someone up to use their car, go to a phone booth and call them up. You can also change your clothing here, don't ask me why. Press the Y button to access the phone booth.

Watch the road four directions. Don't ask me how it works, just be glad it's there to help. Just follow the lights and you'll know you're going in the right direction.
Savor your freedom, my cold-blooded friends!
Perhaps I should consult someone with connections to Springfield's CD underbelly.

Excuse me, Chief Wiggum? Can you help? I've gotta find my brother.
Ah, sorry little girl. I'm busy collecting evidence on Jailbird. We're busting him on the three strikes law.
How many strikes do you have so far?
Uh, no strikes. But that's only because I'm a very, very bad cop.
This is so depressing. I'm going to feed your driver's license to JubJub.
This is terrible. I'm gonna drown my sorrows at the Golden Banana.
This is worse than when Jub-Jub ate my cat.
Good work, Bart. Next time you stay at our place, you can have the steamed vegetable of your choice.
Attaboy, Bart! You're getting a birthday present this year!
Not terrible.
Atta girl, Lisa. This'll be noted on your permanent record.
I'm speechless, Lisa. That was better than you have any right to do.
She must get her driving ability from her mother's side.
I wish I could be happy for your success, but I can't.
Well, I guess your life hasn't been a total waste.
Good work, Marjorie. You're finally turning your life around.
You did better than the American drivers.
That was just barely a pass, even under our low standards, Bart.
You made good time there. Must have been all that flinging from the law you've done.

There he is!
Thank you. Chase again.
Eat fumes, copper!
If you need to really put the hammer down and drive, you can always enter these time trial races. They cost a little to enter, but they have a mucho dinero payoff.
Willie, what are you doing here?
Yeah, they've got to sell my beloved tractor. My father's been thrown in the clink for football hooliganism, and I've no money for his bill.
Well, I certainly could use a tractor around the house for hauling away Homer's empties.
Feel free to get a ride from anybody you see on the street. We Simpsons have done a lot for Springfield, so it's okay to get something back.
During some research, I discovered that you can get a ton of coins by smashing these vending machines. Just double jump over them and do the smash.
Return to the wild!
Way to go, Homer! You da man! Collecting wrenches fixes your car.
